test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

He had not committed the mistake.

options.text: The mistake had not been committed by him.
The mistake has not been committed by him.
The mistake was not committed by him.
Had the mistake been committed by him?

solution:
The correct answer is ** "The mistake had not been committed by him.''**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the active sentence "He had not committed the mistake" , '**He'** is the subject and '**the mistake'** is the object.
 
• The verb in the past Perfect tense is 'had committed'.
 
• When converting from active to passive, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence and vice versa.
 
• This leads to 'the mistake' becoming the subject.
 
• The past participle form of the verb retains ('committed') in the passive voice.
 
• The auxiliary verb 'had' is accompanied by 'been' (as in the rule for converting Past Perfect tense to passive voice).
 
• So in the passive voice, we get "The mistake had been committed by him" [ 'by him' indicating agent of the action].

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
